name: Cheech & Chong - 3 Pack Cryo Infused Pre-Roll - Sour Pebbles (S)
description:
Three joints, extra kick. The Cheech & Chong Sour Pebbles 3-pack gives you three full-gram pre-rolls — 3 grams total — each packed with quality flower and cryo-infused with distillate for a bolder, more potent smoke. No grinding, no rolling, no setup. Just light one and go.

Sour Pebbles brings that cereal-aisle nostalgia with a sour twist: sweet mixed berry and fruity cereal notes up front, cut with a tangy, mouth-watering snap and a smooth, sugary finish. Blended with a sativa terpene profile for an uplifting, energizing feel — bright, fast-moving, and made for daytime.

Why you'll love it:

3 × 1G cryo-infused pre-rolls — 3 grams total, quality flower infused with distillate for extra potency
Cryo-infusion process — locks in flavor and delivers a smooth, even burn
Signature Sour Pebbles flavor — sweet fruity cereal with a tangy, sour snap
Sativa effects — uplifting and energizing, ideal for daytime
Cheech & Chong — a name that's been in the game since day one

Big flavor, dependable potency, and effortless convenience in every pack. Cheech & Chong Sour Pebbles is ready whenever you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets.
